$comment: Spec 036, Befund 1.3: the words of the screen for the internal terms a model may repeat in the chat. The names of the steps (facetoj.json, nomo.de) and the labels of the sliders (Agordilo) come from their own data; here only the general terms of the brand model, longest first where a phrase carries its article. A term mapped to null has no word on the screen: the answer check drops the sentence that names it. Identifiers with an underscore (the names of the tools) and token names of the Modelo have no word either: in parentheses they are left out, elsewhere the sentence goes.

artikel.$comment: Spec 036, Befund 1.3 (Nachbesserung 02.11., A-2): the German articles, so that an article before an internal term turns into the article of the word of the screen (die Kroniko → das Protokoll). A model writes an article in the gender it guesses for the term (genus_im_text in woerter); its form gives the case. After a preposition of dativ_nach the article is read as dative if it can be, otherwise as nominative, accusative, genitive, dative in this order. null: no article (plural without a definite article). verschmelzungen joins a preposition with the new article as German writes it. woerter: The words of the screen with their gender and their four cases, for the terms a model writes with an article. genus_im_text: the gender a model gives the term in German (Kroniko like die Chronik, Agordo like die Einstellung, Aspekto like der Aspekt); it decides only where the article alone leaves the case open (der Aspekto, der Kroniko). The nominative is the word of begriffe.
